pages.text: $(#FFD700)Ranged combat$()$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Poison I/II$() — $(item)Fermented Spider Eye$()$(br)Applies poison on arrow hit (same durations as sword).$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Freezy I/II$() — $(item)Ice$()$(br)Slowness on arrow hit.$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Ranger I$() (1 slot) — $(item)Flint$()$(br)Bow handling bonus, +5% XP.$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Ranger II$() (2 slots) — same item$(br)+10% XP.

$(#FFD700)Also on bow$()$(br2)Speedy (Redstone Block), Scholar (Lapis), Sustaining (Bread), Soulbound (Nether Star), Modifiable (Diamond), Bountiful (Emerald), Scavenger (Hopper), Purifying (Glowstone Dust), Swiftstep (Feather), Bulwark (Brick).$(br2)$(#FF5555)Not allowed:$() Silky, Autosmelt, Momentum, Broad Touch, Moonlit, Frenzy, Sharpy, Titan, Magnetic.
